# StackPodium

> AI tool rankings for vibe coders and builders. Each use case has three ranked tools, the reason for each position and an entry price. Rankings are editorial, based on public documentation; prices were checked in October and November 2026.

## Use cases

- [My first web app, with no coding experience](https://stackpodium.com/first-app/): 1. Lovable, 2. Bolt, 3. Replit
- [A SaaS MVP with login, a database and payments](https://stackpodium.com/saas-mvp/): 1. Lovable, 2. Replit, 3. Bolt
- [A polished interface or landing page, fast](https://stackpodium.com/interface/): 1. v0, 2. Lovable, 3. Bolt
- [A mobile app](https://stackpodium.com/mobile-app/): 1. Bolt, 2. Emergent, 3. Replit
- [Serious coding with an AI editor](https://stackpodium.com/ai-editor/): 1. Cursor, 2. GitHub Copilot, 3. Devin Desktop
- [Hand long tasks to a coding agent](https://stackpodium.com/coding-agent/): 1. Claude Code, 2. Codex, 3. Gemini CLI
- [An agent that automates a task, without code](https://stackpodium.com/no-code-agent/): 1. n8n, 2. Make, 3. Zapier
- [A custom agent, with code](https://stackpodium.com/custom-agent/): 1. LangGraph, 2. CrewAI, 3. OpenAI Agents SDK
- [A playable browser game this weekend](https://stackpodium.com/browser-game/): 1. Rosebud AI, 2. Coding agent + Three.js, 3. GDevelop
- [An internal tool or a data dashboard](https://stackpodium.com/internal-tool/): 1. Replit, 2. Base44, 3. Lovable

## Sponsorship

- [Sponsor StackPodium](https://stackpodium.com/sponsor/): launch rates, valid until May 2027, for one newsletter slot per Friday issue ($49), a labelled Sponsored placement on the site ($99 per month), both together ($129, normally $148 if bought separately), and a featured launch mention ($19). Sponsorship never changes rankings. Audience metrics are shared on request. Contact: [sponsors@stackpodium.com](mailto:sponsors@stackpodium.com?subject=Sponsorship%20inquiry).

## PlayForge

- [PlayForge](https://stackpodium.com/playforge/): a StackPodium studio. Describe a video game idea, pay $9, and receive a Plan Pack by email within 24 hours (a design one-pager, a prototype build plan, and prompts for Cursor or a similar AI coding tool). Two levels: Beginner and Vibe coder. A $29 Premium that builds the browser prototype is not on sale yet. Sponsor PlayForge: [sponsors@stackpodium.com](mailto:sponsors@stackpodium.com?subject=Sponsorship%20inquiry).
- [Game Idea Spark](https://stackpodium.com/playforge/generator/): a free in-browser mini generator. Type a one-line game idea, pick Beginner or Vibe coder, and get a core loop, a weekend prototype scope, a recommended stack, and a first Cursor prompt. Nothing is uploaded.
- [How to make a small top-down heist game with AI this weekend](https://stackpodium.com/playforge/examples/top-down-heist/): a house sample, not a customer order. Vibe coder Plan Pack excerpt for the idea "A top-down heist game where you have 60 seconds to rob a bank before the cops arrive": a design one-pager, a weekend build plan with a done-when line on each step, and the first two Cursor prompts (Phaser 3, Vite, and TypeScript). Independent of GTA VI. PlayForge is not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
- [PlayForge en español](https://stackpodium.com/es/playforge/): the Spanish page for the same $9 Plan Pack. Describe a video game idea, pay $9, and receive a Plan Pack written in Spanish by email within 24 hours (a design one-pager, a prototype build plan, and prompts for Cursor or a similar AI coding tool). Levels: Principiante (nunca ha programado) and Vibe coder. A $29 Premium that builds the browser prototype is coming soon and is not for sale yet.
